ei.title: Native Americans' War Chants and Battle Advantage
ei.subject: 2022 고2 11월 모의고사

fullPassage: Native Americans often sang and danced in preparation for launching an attack. The emotional and neurochemical excitement that resulted from this preparatory singing gave them stamina to carry out their attacks. What may have begun as an unconscious, uncontrolled act — rushing their victims with singing and beating drums in a frenzy — could have become a strategy as the victors saw firsthand the effect their actions had on those they were attacking. Although war dances risk warning an enemy of an upcoming attack, the arousal and synchronizing benefits for the attackers may compensate for the loss of surprise. Humans who sang, danced, and marched may have enjoyed a strong advantage on the battlefield as well as intimidated enemies who witnessed such a spectacle. Nineteenth-and twentieth-century Germans feared no one more than the Scots — the bagpipes and drums were disturbing in their sheer loudness and visual spectacle.

questions.passage: Native Americans often sang and danced in (A)[preparation / celebration] for launching an attack. The emotional and neurochemical excitement that resulted from this preparatory singing gave them (B)[stamina / weakness] to carry out their attacks. Although war dances risk warning an enemy of an upcoming attack, the arousal and synchronizing benefits for the attackers may compensate for the loss of surprise. Humans who sang, danced, and marched may have enjoyed a strong advantage on the battlefield as well as intimidated enemies who witnessed such a spectacle. Nineteenth-and twentieth-century Germans feared no one more than the Scots — the bagpipes and drums were disturbing in their sheer loudness and visual spectacle.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① preparation — stamina — strategy: 원문 일치. 공격을 위한 준비(preparation)로 노래와 춤을 추고, 그 흥분이 체력(stamina)을 주었으며, 이것이 전략(strategy)이 되었다 ←정답
❌ ② celebration(축하): 전투 준비 맥락에서 '축하'는 부적절
❌ ③ weakness(약함): stamina(체력)의 반의어로 맥락 불일치
❌ ④ mistake(실수): strategy(전략)의 반의어 방향으로 부적절
det.tip: preparation(준비)↔celebration(축하), stamina(지구력)↔weakness(약함), strategy(전략)↔mistake(실수)

det.analysis:

❌ ② reassuring(안심시키는): 전투 상황에서 적을 '안심'시킨다는 맥락 불일치

(A) Although war dances <u>risk</u> warning an enemy of an upcoming attack, the arousal and synchronizing benefits for the attackers may compensate for the loss of surprise.

(B) The investor decided not to <u>risk</u> his savings on the new startup because the market was too unpredictable.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 risk의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A) 위험을 감수하다 — (B) 걸다/투자하다: (A)는 전쟁 춤이 경고 노출 '위험을 감수한다'는 동사용법, (B)는 투자자가 저축을 '걸다'는 동사 용법 ←정답
❌ ① (A) 위험(명사): (A)의 risk는 동사로 쓰였음 ('risk warning')
❌ ② (A)(B) 위치 바뀜: (A)가 '위험을 무릅쓰다', (B)가 '위험(명사)'로 바뀐 오답
❌ ④ (A) 경고하다: risk는 경고하다가 아님. '경고할 위험을 감수하다'가 맞는 해석
det.tip: risk(동사): ① 위험을 감수하다 ② (~에) 투자하다/걸다. risk(명사): 위험. 'risk doing'은 '~할 위험을 감수하다'

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

the physical and mental strength that allows you to do something difficult for a long period of time

det.analysis:
✅ ② stamina: '어려운 일을 오랫동안 할 수 있게 해주는 신체적·정신적 힘' = 지구력/체력 ←정답
❌ ① courage(용기): 두려움을 극복하는 정신적 힘이지 지속적 체력이 아님
❌ ③ talent(재능): 능력이지 지구력이 아님
❌ ④ wisdom(지혜): 판단력이지 지구력이 아님
det.tip: stamina(지구력/체력): 장시간 힘든 일을 버티는 능력. endurance(인내력)와 유사

questions.passage: Native Americans often sang and danced in __________ (prepare) for launching an attack.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: prepare(동사) → preparation(명사): 전치사 in 뒤에 명사가 필요. 'in preparation for(~을 위한 준비로)'
det.tip: prepare → preparation(명사). 전치사 뒤 명사형: in preparation for, in celebration of

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: prepare(동사) → preparatory(형용사): 명사 singing을 수식하는 형용사 필요. '준비하는/예비적인 노래'. prepare → preparation → preparatory(형용사 파생)
det.tip: preparatory(형용사): 준비하는. preparatory school(예비학교). prepare→preparatory 형용사 파생 주의

questions.passage: Native Americans often sang and danced in preparation for launching an attack. The emotional and neurochemical excitement that resulted from this preparatory singing gave them stamina to carry out their attacks. What may have begun as an unconscious, uncontrolled act — rushing their victims with singing and beating drums in a frenzy — could have become a strategy as the victors saw firsthand the effect their actions had on those they were attacking. Although war dances risk warning an enemy of an upcoming attack, the arousal and synchronizing benefits for the attackers may compensate for the loss of surprise. Humans who sang, danced, and marched may have enjoyed a strong __________ on the battlefield as well as intimidated enemies who witnessed such a spectacle. Nineteenth-and twentieth-century Germans feared no one more than the Scots — the bagpipes and drums were disturbing in their sheer loudness and visual spectacle.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ advantage: 원문 일치. 노래하고 행진한 인간들이 전장에서 강한 '이점'을 누렸다는 맥락 ←정답
❌ ① burden(부담): 이점이 아닌 부담이라는 맥락 불일치
❌ ② confusion(혼란): 강한 혼란을 즐겼다는 맥락 불일치
❌ ③ disadvantage(불이점): advantage의 반의어로 논리 불일치
det.tip: advantage(이점/유리함): 다른 것보다 나은 위치나 상황. disadvantage(불이점)의 반의어

questions.passage: Native Americans often sang and danced in preparation for launching an attack. The emotional and neurochemical excitement that resulted from this preparatory singing gave them stamina to carry out their attacks. What may have begun as an unconscious, uncontrolled act — rushing their victims with singing and beating drums in a frenzy — could have become a strategy as the victors saw firsthand the effect their actions had on those they were attacking. Although war dances risk warning an enemy of an upcoming attack, the arousal and synchronizing benefits for the attackers may compensate for the loss of surprise. Humans who sang, danced, and marched may have enjoyed a strong advantage on the battlefield as well as intimidated enemies who witnessed such a spectacle. Nineteenth-and twentieth-century Germans feared no one more than the Scots — the bagpipes and drums were __________ in their sheer loudness and visual spectacle.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① disturbing: 원문 일치. 백파이프와 드럼 소리가 순수한 크기와 시각적 광경으로 '불안하게 하는/충격적인' 것이었다는 맥락 ←정답
❌ ② soothing(달래는/진정시키는): disturbing의 반의어로 독일군이 스코틀랜드인을 두려워했다는 맥락 불일치
❌ ③ pleasing(즐거운): 두려움의 대상인 맥락과 불일치
❌ ④ encouraging(격려하는): 적군에게 격려가 되었다는 맥락 불일치
det.tip: disturbing(불안하게 하는/심란한): 사람을 불편하게 만드는. disturb(방해하다/심란하게 하다)의 형용사형
